description: This file is part of a Wi-Fi driver or management component implementing nl80211 netlink communication in C. It includes functions for creating, sending, and handling netlink messages, managing listeners for wireless events, and maintaining the state of nl80211 communication channels. The file handles asynchronous requests, event parsing, and the registration/removal of event listeners, with support for vendor-specific events and group subscription.
